throughline.zh: 本週資料從晶圓與封測擴產授權、記憶體模組新廠及光學元件產能進度，延伸到資料中心電力與物流監管；各公司實績、未來計畫和官方查扣均保留獨立日期與狀態。
throughline.en: This week's coverage spans foundry/test expansion approvals, memory-module and optical component ramps, data-center power and trade enforcement, preserving distinct dates and status for actual results, plans and seizures.

title.zh: 記憶體模組、材料與高速晶片供應
title.en: Memory modules, materials and high-speed chips

summary.zh: 工研院提出稀土材料規劃、騰輝泰國銅箔基板廠已小量出貨，旺宏記憶體擴產仍待 2027 年開出。十銓 10 月 28 日提出新北模組廠 2027 年第二季投產目標；譜瑞則預估第四季高速介面晶片營收季減，這些數字分屬實際、規劃及財測。
summary.en: ITRI presented a rare-earth plan, Tenghui's Thai CCL plant began small shipments and Macronix memory expansion targets 2027. TeamGroup plans Q2 2027 module production while Parade guided lower Q4 interface-chip revenue; actuals, plans and forecasts have different statuses.

title.zh: 晶圓測試、工廠自動化與精密設備
title.en: Wafer testing, factory automation and precision tools

summary.zh: 颱風後電網復原與鴻海 AI 工廠效率資料各屬不同營運場景；國研院與汎銓發表 High-NA EUV 樣品分析方法。中華精測 10 月 28 日新增探針卡營收與 2027 年產能目標，金鞍機械龍潭廠正式啟用，兩案仍有待確認絕對產能與交付。
summary.en: Grid restoration, Foxconn's AI manufacturing measurements and a NARLabs/MSS high-NA EUV metrology method represent separate stages. CHPT reported probe-card results and a 2027 capacity target on October 28, while Jin-An opened its Longtan factory; absolute throughput and deliveries remain distinct.

title.zh: 台灣與東南亞資料中心電力及供應鏈
title.en: Power and data-center infrastructure across Taiwan and Southeast Asia

summary.zh: MViSTA 海纜仍在招標，馬來西亞 500 億美元資料中心投資意向未具正式專案核准；新加坡跨國電力輸入取得條件性核准。台達電公布第三季合併財報，是方電訊報告機房業績與 LY2 進駐率目標；各案的財務實績、投資意向及已併網容量不可混為一談。
summary.en: MViSTA remains in tender, Malaysia's US$50B intention lacks approved projects and Singapore granted conditional power-import approval. Delta published Q3 results and Chief Telecom described data-center revenue and an LY2 occupancy goal; financial results, intentions and energized capacity are different measures.

title.zh: 先進封裝、光通訊與電子測試設備
title.en: Advanced packaging, optics and electronics test equipment

summary.zh: 玉晶光與 3M 光互連合作尚未公布量產客戶驗收；力成先進封裝營收占比已逾三成，FOPLP 仍待量產認證。ASMPT SMT 交易仍屬未簽約洽談，穩懋 10 月 28 日公布光接收 PD 產能爬坡與第三季財報，不能將遠期出貨目標視為已交付。
summary.en: GSEO and 3M's optical interconnect has no published customer volume qualification, while Powertech's advanced packaging share exceeds 30% but FOPLP awaits qualification. ASMPT's SMT divestiture remains unsigned and WIN reported Q3 results and a photodiode ramp on October 28, with future deliveries unconfirmed.

title.zh: 晶圓製造、跨境合作及晶片監管
title.en: Wafer fabrication, regional cooperation and chip controls

summary.zh: 台菲半導體經濟走廊仍為政策討論，Reuters 先前報導越南 Viettel 晶圓廠工地與 DUV 採購未完成，智原另宣布 2 奈米晶片委託設計案。聯電 10 月 28 日核准追加約 32 億美元擴產預算，馬來西亞海關同日公布 15 日查獲的 AI 晶片伺服器案件；核准資本支出與海關查扣均須保留其性質與日期。
summary.en: Philippine semiconductor corridors remain policy discussions, Reuters reported incomplete Viettel fab and DUV milestones, and Faraday disclosed a 2nm design project. UMC authorized about US$3.2B extra expansion on October 28; Malaysian customs separately disclosed an October 15 AI-server seizure, with distinct approval and enforcement dates.
